findings.problem: Empty file with a secret name passes: touch .env (or server.pem), git add -f, commit -> gitleaks.sh tree 0 and range 0, CI green. M0 rejected it. The executor narrowed AC-M0-04 to non-empty files on their own; only the owner may change an AC. Fixing it needs own code (gitleaks skips empty files), which AC-M0.1-02 forbids: needs an owner decision.
findings.required_improvement: Owner decides: (a) record in the plan that AC-M0-04/AC-M0.1-01 mean non-empty files, or (b) allow one name check over `git diff --name-only --diff-filter=AR` in gitleaks.sh as an exception to AC-M0.1-02, with fixtures for empty .env and empty server.pem.

findings.problem: Path regex covers only .env and .env.<x>. `.envrc` with `export DB_PASSWORD=hunter2hunter2` and `.env-local` -> green (tree 0, range 0). The milestone asks for `.env*` in any case; direnv .envrc commonly holds real secrets and a plain password hits no default rule.
findings.required_improvement: Use `\.env[^/]*` (keep the .env.example allowlist) and add fixtures .envrc, .env-local, .ENV_PROD; or have the owner state that `.env*` means only `.env` and `.env.*`.

findings.problem: Self-written network guard with a mature ready tool (pytest-socket: --disable-socket --allow-unix-socket) and no written reason; the M0.1 plan's DoD-6 table omits it although this cycle edited it. Concrete holes: a test doing socket(AF_INET, SOCK_DGRAM).sendto(b'x', ('192.0.2.1', 9)) passes; adding AF_INET6 to _ALLOWED_FAMILIES keeps the whole suite green (module-level set, not mutated by mutmut).
findings.required_improvement: Replace the guard with pinned pytest-socket in addopts (delete _install_network_guard/_no_network/NetworkAccessError), keep the AC-M0-01 tests and add a UDP sendto test that must fail; or record in the plan why the plugin does not fit and close the UDP hole with a test.

findings.problem: mutmut does not mutate module-level constants: 13 single-entry removals from SUBSCHEMA/NAMED_SUBSCHEMAS/SUBSCHEMA_LIST survive the full suite (lock unchanged, so equivalent on today's schemas).
